# SafeOrStolen

> SafeOrStolen is a stolen item verification platform. Users check IMEI numbers, VIN numbers, serial numbers, and firearm serial numbers against law enforcement, insurance, and carrier databases to verify if secondhand items are stolen, lost, or safe to buy. 2 free checks, results in 3 seconds. Subscription is $1/month for unlimited checks.

## Unique Features

- Only verification service that analyzes marketplace listing URLs (Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, Poshmark) to auto-extract identifiers and check stolen status
- Covers ALL secondhand item types: phones, vehicles, bicycles, firearms, laptops, electronics, tools, jewelry
- Progressive Web App with barcode scanning for iOS and Android
- Checks against NCIC, GSMA Device Registry, carrier blacklists, insurance claims, police reports, BikeIndex, and 100+ databases
